newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain leaves key rate steady at 7.25 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain leaves key rate steady at 7.25 pct.

text.p: The Bank of Spain said it left its key money rate unchanged at 7.25 percent at today's regular repurchase tender for central bank certificates.
It allotted 4.176 trillion pesetas against 4.643 trillion bid.

Seven of eight analysts surveyed by Reuters on Monday had expected the Bank of Spain to keep the rate unchanged. They predicted the central bank would wait for August inflation data and details on the 1997 budget before cutting again.
